resources.string: Automatic follows your download order in Audio Lab.
New downloads use only the selected provider. The track must be available there as a downloadable file.
This provider is unavailable for the selected quality. Choose another provider or Automatic.
A download failed with this provider and quality. Retry the download or choose another provider.
Modules use the selected tier when they offer it. Lossless always requires a complete FLAC or ALAC file.
Choose a folder to also save downloads as audio files you can open in Files.
Completed downloads are saved as audio files in this folder. Pippo keeps an offline copy for playback.
Some files could not be saved. Check folder access and tap Copy existing downloads to retry.
Pippo needs permission to read and write in this folder. Choose it again or select another folder.
